details.name: get_attendance_dates
details.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION coderdojo.get_attendance_dates()
 RETURNS TABLE(date text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT DISTINCT date
  FROM coderdojo.member_attendances
  WHERE date IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY date DESC;
$function$

details.name: get_attendance_stats
details.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION coderdojo.get_attendance_stats()
 RETURNS TABLE(date text, attendance_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT
    date,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS attendance_count
  FROM coderdojo.member_attendances
  WHERE date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY date
  ORDER BY date DESC;
$function$

details.name: get_attendance_stats_split
details.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION coderdojo.get_attendance_stats_split()
 RETURNS TABLE(date text, mentor_count bigint, ninja_count bigint, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT
    ma.date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_mentor THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS mentor_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_ninja THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS ninja_count,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS total_count
  FROM coderdojo.member_attendances ma
  LEFT JOIN coderdojo.members m ON m.id = ma.member_id
  WHERE ma.date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ma.date
  ORDER BY ma.date DESC;
$function$

details.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION coderdojo.can_read_mentor_pods()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from auth.users a join coderdojo.members m on a.email=m.id::text||'@coderdojoennis.com'
  where a.id=(select auth.uid()) and a.email_confirmed_at is not null and m.is_mentor and not m.deleted);
$function$
